label: input 0 or u during original phase, late or after earlier 0/u/d
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase (never at t=0, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase). Driven by the current input token: 0 and u make up about 84% of activation mass (rate about 12% each), with weaker firing on d and f and almost none elsewhere. Firing on 0/u is gated by context. It is more likely and stronger later in the sequence (rate rises from 0.5% at t=1 to about 5% at t>=5) and when 0/u/d appeared earlier, so repeated or consecutive 0/u inputs give the highest activations (e.g. o h p 0 u 0, where the third token reaches the max). Sequences with many digits raise the rate. Most 0/u inputs early in a sequence with no earlier 0/u/d do not fire. Predicate dev F1 about 0.55, mass recall 0.76; the leftover activation mass is weak firing on d/f/q/h and misses whose cause is unclear, so this is only a partial explanation.
